title: Empty set
summary: The empty set is the set with no members.

context.note: This node belongs to one explicit foundational presentation; alternate foundations may encode it differently.

assumptions.text: The declared set-like mathematics context is fixed.

content.plain: The empty set is the set with no members.
content.exact: ∅ is characterized by ∀x(x∉∅); extensionality makes any two memberless sets identical.
content.example: The solution set of x²=-1 over the real numbers is empty.
content.caveat: Existence of an empty set is an axiom or construction depending on the foundation.
